start.card:
A box is 3 cubes long, 2 wide and 2 tall. Then we make a bigger box: twice as long, twice as wide and twice as tall.
How much more paint and water will the big box need? Make a guess first.
start.title: Double the box

afterGuess.card: Let's test it with real cubes. Build the small box: press "Add a layer" until it is full.
afterGuess.title: Double the box

after.card:
Painted! The small box has 32 red squares on the outside.
Now make every side twice as long and build the big box the same way.
after.title: Double the box
visibleButtons: Build the big box (twice as long, wide and tall)
